caption: The drawing depicts a traditional hand saw composed of several wooden and metal parts. The main frame consists of two curved vertical wooden arms that are light brown with visible wood grain, connected at the top by a horizontal metal rod and roughly in the middle by a straight wooden stretcher that is slightly darker in color. At the base, a long, straight serrated metal saw blade is fixed between the ends of the vertical arms, with triangular teeth evenly spaced along the cutting edge. The top metal rod is tensioned and has two round wooden knobs, one at each upper end of the frame, with a twisted device in the center to adjust the tension. The background is a plain off-white or beige color and there are no additional objects in the composition.
title: Bucksaw
